sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner although defended the case by saying that it was a case of consensual relationship turned soured.
Both shared physical/emotional proximity on their own volition, but when marriage could not be solemnized, then result is the instant case.

Learned counsel for the petitioner fairly submits that he is ready to withdraw this petition seeking liberty to raise all the grounds/points available to him as per law and as per the mandate of Apex Court from time to time before the Trial Court.
Petition stands disposed of with aforesaid liberty to raise all the grounds.
